project_points_to_image_plane: project 3D points to 2D coordinates on the image plane using camera intrinsics and extrinsics
transform_cameras_resize: transform camera intrinsics and dimensions by a given resize factor for scaled rendering
generate_rays_single_camera: generate camera rays with origins, directions, and radii for a single camera setup
generate_rays_multiple_cameras: generate rays for multiple cameras with optional near and far clipping planes
generate_rays_opencv_format: generate rays in OpenCV format with normalized view directions and computed ray radii
